speaker: mother_skarrow
text: So. The valley sends swords instead of grain. I expected it.
renderText: So. The valley sends swords instead of grain. I expected it.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Come, then. My grandchildren are watching, and they are hungry.
renderText: Come, then. My grandchildren are watching, and they are hungry.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: You lock your grain and call us thieves. Now you come to finish it.
renderText: You lock your grain and call us thieves. Now you come to finish it.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Old, yes. Soft, no.
renderText: Old, yes. Soft, no.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Hah. The hill is crooked. Like your mayor.
renderText: Hah. The hill is crooked. Like your mayor.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Forty winters I have bled for this clan. Your turn.
renderText: Forty winters I have bled for this clan. Your turn.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Go down to the river. Tell it Skarrow sent you.
renderText: Go down to the river. Tell it Skarrow sent you.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Up, little one. Up. Ah. No.
renderText: Up, little one. Up. Ah. No.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Not yet. The little ones have not eaten.
renderText: Not yet. The little ones have not eaten.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: I have buried better than you. I will not be buried by you.
renderText: I have buried better than you. I will not be buried by you.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Go home. Tell them the bridge stays ours until the grain comes.
renderText: Go home. Tell them the bridge stays ours until the grain comes.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Whatever you think of me, feed the little ones. Feed them.
renderText: Whatever you think of me, feed the little ones. Feed them.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Valley people. Walking. Not running at me with spears. This is new.
renderText: Valley people. Walking. Not running at me with spears. This is new.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Forty winters I have held this clan. Do not ask me if I can hold it one more.
renderText: Forty winters I have held this clan. Do not ask me if I can hold it one more.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Sit. You are guests now, which is worse than enemies. Guests we have to feed.
renderText: Sit. You are guests now, which is worse than enemies. Guests we have to feed.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Valley people. Walking. Not running at me with spears. This is new.
renderText: Valley people. Walking. Not running at me with spears. This is new.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: You lock your grain and call us thieves. Sit. We will talk about who stole what.
renderText: You lock your grain and call us thieves. Sit. We will talk about who stole what.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Two-day bread. From the innkeeper, yes? The one who feeds anybody.
renderText: Two-day bread. From the innkeeper, yes? The one who feeds anybody.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Small kindness. Small stomachs. It is not nothing.
renderText: Small kindness. Small stomachs. It is not nothing.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Ha! Somebody's mother taught you properly. You say my name like you have been scolded with it.
renderText: Ha! Somebody's mother taught you properly. You say my name like you have been scolded with it.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Then you know a hill word the valley does not have. It means a debt that both sides pretend is a gift.
renderText: Then you know a hill word the valley does not have. It means a debt that both sides pretend is a gift.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Then you saw. My little ones were down on the bank, digging roots. Your people shot at them.
renderText: Then you saw. My little ones were down on the bank, digging roots. Your people shot at them.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: We took the bridge after. Not before. Tell your captain that, if she will hear it.
renderText: We took the bridge after. Not before. Tell your captain that, if she will hear it.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Here is the bargain, and it is a short one. Your town eats. My clan eats. The bridge goes back to being a bridge.
renderText: Here is the bargain, and it is a short one. Your town eats. My clan eats. The bridge goes back to being a bridge.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Not coin. Coin does not boil. A share of the grain your mayor keeps behind his locks. Every week, until the thaw.
renderText: Not coin. Coin does not boil. A share of the grain your mayor keeps behind his locks. Every week, until the thaw.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Half now, half at the thaw. You bargain like a hill grandmother. I will take it, and I will watch you.
renderText: Half now, half at the thaw. You bargain like a hill grandmother. I will take it, and I will watch you.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Half? My children do not eat half. All of it, every week, or go home and fetch your captain.
renderText: Half? My children do not eat half. All of it, every week, or go home and fetch your captain.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: But you climbed the hill. So. Sit down again, and agree with me.
renderText: But you climbed the hill. So. Sit down again, and agree with me.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Most of them. Some of the young ones belong to my grandson now, in their hearts. Vorga. He left us to take instead of ask.
renderText: Most of them. Some of the young ones belong to my grandson now, in their hearts. Vorga. He left us to take instead of ask.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: His friends will not like a truce. If they bare their teeth on the bridge, do not kill more of them than you must.
renderText: His friends will not like a truce. If they bare their teeth on the bridge, do not kill more of them than you must.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Forty winters I have held this clan. Do not ask me if I can hold it one more.
renderText: Forty winters I have held this clan. Do not ask me if I can hold it one more.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Then it is agreed. Tell your mayor the old mother will give back his bridge. Tell him she is counting the sacks.
renderText: Then it is agreed. Tell your mayor the old mother will give back his bridge. Tell him she is counting the sacks.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: I see you, valley people. You came with spears after all. I hoped. I am old enough to know better than hope.
renderText: I see you, valley people. You came with spears after all. I hoped. I am old enough to know better than hope.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Come, then. Every one of us you kill is one less mouth this winter. Your mayor will be so pleased.
renderText: Come, then. Every one of us you kill is one less mouth this winter. Your mayor will be so pleased.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Hm. Well fought. My grandson always said the valley would never share. I should have listened to him.
renderText: Hm. Well fought. My grandson always said the valley would never share. I should have listened to him.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: There was a song I meant to teach somebody. Too late now. It goes into the river with me.
renderText: There was a song I meant to teach somebody. Too late now. It goes into the river with me.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Seven went up where the wall meets the sky. No. Not for you. Not for the ones with spears.
renderText: Seven went up where the wall meets the sky. No. Not for you. Not for the ones with spears.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: My grandson's friends. They would rather die on the stones than eat valley bread. Foolish children.
renderText: My grandson's friends. They would rather die on the stones than eat valley bread. Foolish children.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Do what you must. But I have buried enough of them this year. Leave me some to scold.
renderText: Do what you must. But I have buried enough of them this year. Leave me some to scold.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: They will go to him. He will tell them they were brave. They were. Brave is cheap this winter.
renderText: They will go to him. He will tell them they were brave. They were. Brave is cheap this winter.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Your captain thinks. Good. Tell her to think about the grain.
renderText: Your captain thinks. Good. Tell her to think about the grain.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Sit. You are guests now, which is worse than enemies. Guests we have to feed.
renderText: Sit. You are guests now, which is worse than enemies. Guests we have to feed.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: When the bellies are full, the clan sings. Tonight I sing the old one, because my bones say I should.
renderText: When the bellies are full, the clan sings. Tonight I sing the old one, because my bones say I should.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: The valley song. Seven went over, seven came home, they brought something heavy. Yes. Pretty.
renderText: The valley song. Seven went over, seven came home, they brought something heavy. Yes. Pretty.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Your song was made by the ones who came home. Ours was made by the ones who watched them come.
renderText: Your song was made by the ones who came home. Ours was made by the ones who watched them come.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Hm. I thought you smelled wrong. Not bad. Only far. Like snow from the other side.
renderText: Hm. I thought you smelled wrong. Not bad. Only far. Like snow from the other side.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Then listen close. This song is about your side of the mountain, a little. Perhaps it is about you.
renderText: Then listen close. This song is about your side of the mountain, a little. Perhaps it is about you.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Seven went up where the wall meets the sky, seven with nothing, and hungry, and cold.
renderText: Seven went up where the wall meets the sky, seven with nothing, and hungry, and cold.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Seven came down when the snow was still falling, seven came down with their hands full of gold.
renderText: Seven came down when the snow was still falling, seven came down with their hands full of gold.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: But nobody runs when they carry a fortune. Seven came down, and the seven came running.
renderText: But nobody runs when they carry a fortune. Seven came down, and the seven came running.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: That is the next verse. And the next verse is not for strangers.
renderText: That is the next verse. And the next verse is not for strangers.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: You fed my children. That makes you something. Not family. Not yet. Come back when you are.
renderText: You fed my children. That makes you something. Not family. Not yet. Come back when you are.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: You ask well. So, a crumb. In the old song the gold is not gold. We sing gold because it rhymes, and the true word is sad.
renderText: You ask well. So, a crumb. In the old song the gold is not gold. We sing gold because it rhymes, and the true word is sad.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: The rest when you are family. Not before. Now eat. You are too thin for valley people.
renderText: The rest when you are family. Not before. Now eat. You are too thin for valley people.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: You fed my children, valley people. So I give you what I do not give to strangers. Not all of it. The last verse stays with the clan.
renderText: You fed my children, valley people. So I give you what I do not give to strangers. Not all of it. The last verse stays with the clan.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Seven went over the Greywall in the long winters, and seven came back with fire. They came back running.
renderText: Seven went over the Greywall in the long winters, and seven came back with fire. They came back running.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: The song says the fire had a home on the far side of the mountains. The seven took it. It was not theirs to take.
renderText: The song says the fire had a home on the far side of the mountains. The seven took it. It was not theirs to take.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Your Wardens sang that it was given. We never warmed our hands at it, so we never forgot. It was stolen.
renderText: Your Wardens sang that it was given. We never warmed our hands at it, so we never forgot. It was stolen.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: My grandson Vorga holds the bridge you need. He is a fool and a thief, and he is mine.
renderText: My grandson Vorga holds the bridge you need. He is a fool and a thief, and he is mine.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Do not kill him, if you can help it. Beat him if you must. Then send him home to me.
renderText: Do not kill him, if you can help it. Beat him if you must. Then send him home to me.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Warm again. Good for the children. But watch. In ten winters you valley folk will forget you owe us grain.
renderText: Warm again. Good for the children. But watch. In ten winters you valley folk will forget you owe us grain.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: We never used your fire, so we will remember for you. Somebody has to sing it.
renderText: We never used your fire, so we will remember for you. Somebody has to sing it.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Cold again, like the old songs. Now you valley folk learn what we know. Sit. We will teach you how to winter.
renderText: Cold again, like the old songs. Now you valley folk learn what we know. Sit. We will teach you how to winter.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Neighbours. That is your word for people you shout at and still feed. Good. We will be neighbours.
renderText: Neighbours. That is your word for people you shout at and still feed. Good. We will be neighbours.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: You lock your grain and call us thieves. Come, then, valley folk. Take the bridge from an old woman.
renderText: You lock your grain and call us thieves. Come, then, valley folk. Take the bridge from an old woman.

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: They are in the water! Shoot them while they wade, children!
renderText: They are in the water! Shoot them while they wade, children!

speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Forty winters I have buried grandchildren. I will not bury more for you. Sing with me!
renderText: Forty winters I have buried grandchildren. I will not bury more for you. Sing with me!
